description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring. This appears in every notification.

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms, max 3600000ms. Ignored when persistent is true.

persistent.description: Run for the lifetime of the session with no timeout. Use for session-length watches like PR monitoring or log tails. Stop with TaskStop.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

url.description: WebSocket endpoint. Must be an ASCII ws:// or wss:// URL with no embedded credentials or whitespace.

protocols.description: Optional WebSocket subprotocol names to offer during the handshake.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.
